subject: Working with Viz.ai to improve diagnostic accuracy of AI models
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

With your team's recent focus on optimising your deep learning models with the growing ML team I thought I'd reach out. 

I've recently been working with Qure.ai, Subtle Medical, Viz.ai working on lesion segmentation models to improve segmentation precision and diagnostic reliability with DICOM-native annotation and validation tools. 

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: Mushrooms too? | Helping w/ tomatoes & blueberries harvesting
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're building robots to pick mushrooms so I thought to reach out.
We help Four Growers, Bloomfield, Carbon Robotics and Aigen to automate
various agricultural tasks, e.g. tomato harvesting, blueberries counting,
weeding etc. Thought it's worth saying hi!

For context - we help robotics companies accelerate perception model
development, by unifying data curation, annotation and model evaluation in
one platform. Happy to share our perspectives working with over 200 AI
teams including aforementioned Agtech co's, Pickle Robots, Weave Robotics
etc.

We've been following your mushroom harvesting robots for a while now -
would be great to introduce ourselves. Let me know if you're open for a 20
mins chat Tuesday or Friday next week?

subject: Woven's data curation solution
text:
Hi [NAME],​

We've recently started working with Woven, Wayve, and Oxa - so thought it could be interesting to reach out to explore if we can help at McLaren in a similar way.

The common challenges these teams faced were around existing data visualisation / curation solutions (internal tools), lacking the speed & scalability required to efficiently visualise their training datasets (struggling beyond ~1m frames).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing / searching through billions of multimodal data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters, & natural language searches), enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Woven, Wayve, Oxa and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?
